rows.en: Ah, I can hear it…
Direction and position?
Ah, there it is!?
The transmission is definitely coming from this building.
All right… let's go inside!
Heh heh heh… Welcome, gentlemen of Unicorn!
Who are you? The BF?

That's right!

I am Dracula, the vampire who wanders the cosmos! Hah hah hah…
A vampire?

I will drain the humans of Earth of every drop of blood and make them fellow vampires!

So that they will obey Emperor Guillotine's orders nice and well. First, I'll help myself to your blood…

We won't let you!

This is U7, this is U7! Japan Branch, come in! Japan Branch, come in! Emergency message!
What's wrong, U7? What are you in such a panic about?
We're in trouble! It's the BF! The BF ambushed us!!

Understood. I'll report to the Branch Chief at once! U7, hang in there!

Kyaaah!!

…!?

Japan Branch, what happened!? Marie!?
Daisaku, what's wrong?
I don't know… but the transmission suddenly cut off! Maybe something happened at the Japan Branch?
Heh heh heh… You can't escape now! Look around you!
Damn it… Minami, I'll take the Gigants outside!
Huh… wait a sec, so I get this monster?
All right…!
Don't move, boy… Look!!
What are you doing to Marie?
Move even one step! Unicorn's cute little girl will become a vampire, you know?
Damn it…
U7, I'm sorry…
Boy… give Giant Robo an order!
Huh…?
But that order will be to move Giant Robo and have it destroy the Unicorn Japan Branch.
What?
Something like that… I'd never say it, even if it kills me!
If you won't obey my orders, instead of killing you, I'll take that girl's life!!
Marie's?
That's dirty!
I'll count to five… Make up your mind by then!
Kuh…

One…

Two…
Ugh…

Three…

Four…
Wait!
U7, you're not really going to…!?

Now testing the controller…

OBOR REDRO SIHT YEBO T'NOD… OBOR REDRO SIHT YEBO T'NOD…
What are you doing!? Say it, now!

OBOR REDRO SIHT YEBO T'NOD… OBOR REDRO SIHT YEBO T'NOD…

DON'T OBEY THIS ORDER, ROBO! DON'T OBEY THIS ORDER, ROBO!
Robo! Destroy the Unicorn Japan Branch!
Daisaku, you idiooot!!
Good, scream more, scream!!
Giant Robo, launch!!

Heh heh heh… Gentlemen of Unicorn!

From now on, you'll become vampires and work as the BF's pawns! I'll start by sucking your blood!!
Robooo!!

…!?

Giant Robo!?

Why!? Why isn't it heading for the Unicorn Japan Branch?

Hey, serves you right! Robo's on our side!

Robo! Crush Dracula!!
Damn it… Giant Robo! Behold the might of the great Dracula!

…!?

Dracula has grown giant…!
Robo! Take out Dracula!

Oh, that's right! A vampire's weakness is the cross!

Robo! Make a Cross Fire!
We did it!!
Marie!!
I'm all right, Daisaku…
Still… that was one scary guy, huh? I almost got turned into a vampire.
A beanpole vampire wouldn't be very cool, would it?
That's harsh! U6…
Heh heh… Come on, let's contact the Branch Chief.
Uwaah…

…!?

Daisaku! Hang in there! Daisaku!
Daisaku!

This is U3, this is U3! Japan Branch, Japan Branch!!

Emergency!

U7 has been shot by the BF!
What!?
Hurry, hurry, send an ambulance!
Branch Chief…!
Right, we're heading to the rescue at once!

Hang in there, U7!

If you die on us now, who will control Giant Robo? Who will protect the peace of the Earth? Daisaku…

Heh heh heh… That was a close call, wasn't it?

It seems the Space Vampire Dracula has been defeated, but the U7 assassination operation appears to have gone well.
Now Giant Robo won't move! It's become a mere lump of iron! Launch GR-2!!
Looks like Daisaku got shot by the BF!

What!?

So, is he all right?

Apparently he was rushed to the TDF-affiliated hospital, but…

there's no news on his condition yet.
Then what about the BF?

With Giant Robo unable to launch, their monster robots are running wild!

Apparently the security team went out to fight them, but…
I'm worried about Daisaku…

uncertain: U14942/U14944: Daisaku's backwards code ボロ イレイメ ナクキ (= メイレイ キクナ ロボ reversed) recreated as English spelled backwards: 'OBOR REDRO SIHT YEBO T'NOD' -> 'DON'T OBEY THIS ORDER, ROBO!'. Capitals used as it is an order to the robot.
U14908/U14953: ドラキュラン rendered 'Dracula' per glossary.
U14961/U14962: ノッポ (tall) rendered 'beanpole'; Juro Minami is the target of the joke.
U14975: narration row with no speaker begins mid-quote; reads as Taki's report (he speaks in U14977).
U14979: 怪ロボット rendered 'monster robots'.

new_names.why: glossary has GR－2=GR-2; source here lacks the dash
